Scenes

Add layers to a scene
ngs_layer_names() ngs_layer() `ngs_layer<-`() ngs_drop_layer() ngs_move_layer()

ngs_base_url() `ngs_base_url<-`()
Base URL of a scene

Segmentation layers

These helpers accept a segmentation layer or a scene. For scenes, use layer to pick the layer.

ngs_segments() ngs_add_segments() ngs_remove_segments()
Selected segments
ngs_set_colors()
Set segment colours
ngs_color_by()
Colour segments by a property
ngs_clear_colors()
Clear segment colours
ngs_invert()
Invert segment selection

ngs_as_flavour() ngs_flavour() ngs_for_viewer()
